lines.tts: No human has ever climbed this mountain.
Everest is two kilometres taller. It's been climbed over thirteen thousand times.

caps: This is *MOUNT KAILASH,* | the home of *SHIVA.*
lines.tts: This is Mount Kailash, the home of Shiva.

caps: Four great rivers | begin near it:
lines.tts: Four great rivers begin near it: the Indus, the Sutlej, the Brahmaputra, and the Karnali.

caps: *REINHOLD MESSNER,* | the first man to climb | all 14 of the world's | highest peaks,
lines.tts: Reinhold Messner, the first man to climb all fourteen of the world's highest peaks, was offered the chance. He refused.

caps: He said: | “If we conquer | this mountain,
lines.tts: He said: if we conquer this mountain, we conquer something in people's souls.

caps: So pilgrims | don't climb it. | They walk *AROUND* it.
lines.tts: So pilgrims don't climb it. They walk around it.

caps: Over *50 KM,* | across a pass | at *5,600 METRES,*
lines.tts: Over fifty kilometres, across a pass at five thousand six hundred metres, keeping Shiva on their right.
It's pradakshina, around Shiva's own home.

caps: Has anyone in | *YOUR FAMILY* done | the *KAILASH YATRA?*
lines.tts: Has anyone in your family done the Kailash yatra? Comment your city!
